title: How to create an offset line with exactly the same curve length as the original pattern
content:
Hello, I would like to ask about creating offset lines in CLO.

My goal is to create an offset line that keeps **exactly the same curve shape and curve length** as the original pattern curve. However, when I use the Offset Pattern or Offset as Internal Line function, the offset curve slightly changes its shape and length, especially on curved segments.

I would like the offset line to be a true parallel curve, maintaining the same curvature and geometry as the original pattern edge.

Could you please advise:

  * Is there a way in CLO to generate an offset line that preserves the exact curve shape and length?

  * Or is this a current limitation of the offset algorithm in CLO?

  * Are there any recommended workflows or tools to achieve a precise offset for curved pattern lines?




Thank you very much for your help.

![75ef675dc7b2442498c14974c4393110](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/d7d22f3474784f79b41a06c0675632af/images/75ef675dc7b2442498c14974c4393110Screenshot%202026-02-04%20114851.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: If you want precisely the same line, you can use the Trace tool (shortcut i), right-click on the line in question and trace as an internal line, then drag that line into the desired position. I don't know what you're trying to achieve but here you can see an example of the exact same line not actually giving a "parallel" result due to the curving involved. Purple-marked is with the offset function by 50mm and green with when traced as an internal line and then moved upwards by 50mm.
content_description: This webpage aims to provide guidance on creating accurate offset lines in CLO that maintain the original curve shape and length, addressing user inquiries and potential limitations of the software.

title: CURL(35) SSL connect error
content:
I can't log in to the program. I followed all the recommendations to fix the problem, but I still can't log in to the program. I have home internet.

The SSL connection setup has encountered an error. Please check your firewall or proxy server settings. For Allow-listing CLO Endpoints information, refer to the provided link. Click Here.

CURL(35) SSL connect error 

* * *

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi. Here are a few things to check on your computer as this error is due to your computers connectionCheck Firewall and Antivirus: The most common cause is security software blocking CLO3D. Temporarily disable your firewall or antivirus to see if that resolves the issue. If it does, add CLO.exe to your exception list.Verify System Date/Time: Incorrect date and time settings on your computer can prevent SSL certificates from validating.Company Proxy/Network: If using a corporate network, the firewall may be blocking the connection. Contact your IT department to allow connections to CLO3D servers.Update Software: Ensure you are using the latest version of CLO3D, as older versions may use outdated security protocols.Clear Browser Cache: If logging in via the web browser, clearing cache/cookies can resolve authentication issues. For further help with this you will need to reach out to our CLO Tec Support directly - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/a565ab53b9144dbf827fd76d9aaf0905
content_description: This page aims to provide troubleshooting guidance and support for users experiencing SSL connection errors while attempting to log in to the program.

title: Graded PDF issue
content:
I am trying to export my graded patterns from CLO 3D to Adobe Illustrator to add final text and markings. However, I am facing two major issues:

  1. When I export a graded PDF, only the **base size** is visible when I open it in Illustrator.

  2. If I use the **'Print Layout'** method to bring all graded sizes into Illustrator, only the **base size** has its notches. The notches for all other sizes are missing or not transferred from CLO.




I have spent a week trying every possible setting and method, but I cannot get all sizes with their respective notches into Illustrator. I urgently need help to resolve this.

Thank you in advance

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: We understand your frustration. This is a highly requested feature and it is currently on our roadmap. While I don't have a specific timeline to share yet, please stay tuned for future updates.

Comment 2: Hi there,Currently, we don't support exporting all grading sizes into a single PDF. To ensure you have the full information for each size, please export them individually, one by one.
Reply 1: Hi,Thank you for your response. However, I must express that exporting each size individually is an extremely time-consuming and labor-intensive workaround, especially when working with a high number of grading sizes. This manual process significantly increases the risk of human error and slows down our production workflow.As a professional user, I believe a "Single PDF Export for all grading sizes" (either as nested lines or layered PDF) is a fundamental requirement for a modern 3D fashion design software.Could you please provide information on the following:Is there a plan to include a "Nested PDF Export" or "Multi-size PDF" feature in the upcoming 2026 updates?Is this feature currently on your development roadmap (R&D stage)?This improvement would save us hours of repetitive work. Looking forward to your updates.
content_description: This webpage aims to provide solutions and guidance for exporting graded patterns from CLO 3D to Adobe Illustrator, specifically addressing issues with visibility of graded sizes and transfer of notches.

title: 안감 패딩 작업을 위한 Pressure 팁 3가지 (by. Bler)
content:
안녕하세요, 실무 중심 프리미엄 러닝 플랫폼 블러Bler입니다.  
  
CLO로 패딩 작업을 하다 보면 의외로 손이 많이 가고, 공들인 것에 비해 실물 느낌이 안 나서 고민될 때가 많죠. 실무에서 패딩의 완성도를 높이고 작업 시간은 단축하기 위해 습관적으로 사용하는 한 끗 차이 팁을 공유합니다.  
  
**1️⃣ 누빔선 트레이스 한 번에 끝내는 락(Lock)의 활용**  
패딩 퀼팅 라인이 많을 때 하나하나 클릭하는 건 너무 고된 작업이죠. 이럴 때 [Lock All Pattern Outlines]를 활용해 아주 빠르게 베이스 라인을 추출합니다.  
  
**실무 Tip:** 빈 바탕 우클릭으로 외곽선을 잠근 뒤 전체 드래그를 해보세요. 클릭 몇 번 없이도 내부 라인만 깔끔하게 선택됩니다. 그 상태에서 바로 인터널 라인(Internal Line)으로 변환하면 누빔 준비 끝! 작은 습관이지만 작업 텐션이 확 올라갑니다.![0046f7de61384b21ace211feddaa6feb](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/a0d32c53c28d4b05b5b407c137d8e233/images/0046f7de61384b21ace211feddaa6feb01-1.webp)  
**2️⃣ 자연스러운 볼륨감을 위한 프레셔(Pressure) 세트 세팅**  
패딩의 빵빵함은 프레셔 값에서 오지만, 무작정 높인다고 예쁘게 나오진 않더라고요. 안감과 겉감에 **상반된 힘** 을 주어 균형을 잡는 방식이 더 선호됩니다.  
  
**실무 Tip:** 겉감에는 **플러스(+)** , 안감에는 **마이너스(-)** 값을 세트로 줘보세요. 겉은 부풀고 안은 몸에 착 붙으면서 실물 패딩 특유의 구조가 잡힙니다. 저는 보통 **5/-5** 나 **10/-10** 정도로 시작해서 눈으로 확인하며 미세 조정을 합니다. 핵심은 양쪽 수치를 세트로 맞춰야 옷의 밸런스가 무너지지 않는다는 점이에요!![3ed8ba6eda9840989ac90440a61fc35b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/a0d32c53c28d4b05b5b407c137d8e233/images/3ed8ba6eda9840989ac90440a61fc35b02-1.webp)  
**3️⃣ 엘라스틱(Elastic) 97%로 만드는 리얼한 잔주름**  
시뮬레이션 후 결과물이 너무 매끈해서 컴퓨터 그래픽 느낌이 강하다면 **엘라스틱** 을 써보세요.  
  
**실무 Tip:** 퀼팅 라인을 선택하고 엘라스틱을 **97% 정도** 로 살짝만 줘보세요. 누빔 부위가 아주 미세하게 수축하면서 원단에 생동감 있는 잔주름이 생깁니다. 100%일 때보다 훨씬 '옷 같은' 느낌이 나죠. 특히 나일론 소재를 쓸 때 이 3%의 차이가 결과물의 급을 바꿔놓곤 합니다.![979ca44926034456b8a7427bd9859988](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/a0d32c53c28d4b05b5b407c137d8e233/images/979ca44926034456b8a7427bd985998803-1.webp)  
더 다양한 아이템에 적용할 수 있는 디테일링 기법이나 실무 CLO 유저의 워크플로우가 궁금하시다면, CLO 커뮤니티 유저분들에게만 공개하는 [CLO 응용 클래스] 무료 공개 강의 링크를 확인해 주세요!  
  
[▶ 블러Bler의 CLO + AI 응용 클래스 14강 무료 맛보기](https://youtu.be/Go9NC8_EfEM?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=pid_70&utm_content=connect_nohsoohyun_01)
content_description: "블러Bler는 실무 중심의 패딩 작업 팁과 CLO 응용 클래스를 통해 여러분의 디자인 완성도를 높이고 작업 효율을 극대화합니다."
